algorithm.retraction: Any claim depending on a withdrawn source is marked reopened (not false). A claim with status unpaid remains unpaid. Unrelated independently grounded claims retain their status.
algorithm.prohibition: No edge automatically promotes author assertions or observed precipitation into device causality; model statuses are bibliographic, not ontology truth. An uploader's third-person promotional biography cannot certify Navy employment, historical device construction, or Flanagan-Gentry-Croft technical handoff.
